# Anchor Therapy

> Anchor Therapy provides evidence-based psychotherapy and teletherapy services across New Jersey, New York, and Florida, specializing in CBT treatment for anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship issues.

Anchor Therapy is a mental health counseling practice based in Hoboken, NJ, serving Hudson County and surrounding areas including Jersey City, Weehawken, Montclair, and Bergen County. The practice offers both in-person and telehealth sessions for individuals, couples, children, teens, and families, with specialized expertise in cognitive behavioral therapy and trauma-informed care.

## Key Topics
